# Analytics composition boundary checks

G1/G3 scoped source/HTTP evidence under I7/I8/I11/I17 and
[converted-core-v1](../design/converted-component-standard.md). This adds missing
coverage, not a new security policy, public API or complete security certification.

## Boundary and result

The Gallery recipe now delegates to an unexported, immutable builder seam. Production
still selects `buildAnalyticsJourney`; tests supply hostile synthetic datasets through
the same handler implementation, including its trusted `template.HTML` handoff.
There is no mutable global fixture, new endpoint or change to production rendering.

The added tests verify:

- Parsed complete HTML retains hostile title, unit, grain, source, row, legend and
  missing-reason text without injected active elements or event attributes. Both a
  fitting SVG/legend and the explicit long-label table-only result are exercised.
- Explicit HTTPS source links remain supported; executable `javascript:` and `data:`
  source links become plain text. Origin confinement is not the source-link contract;
  the initial protocol-relative-link concern was withdrawn without changing policy.
- An independent CSV reader checks the exact context/data schema, formula-prefix
  neutralization, role meaning, numeric zero and absent values. Expected bytes are
  not generated by calling the writer under test. CSV text encoding is not a
  lossless raw-data format or proof of every spreadsheet application's behavior.
- Download filename, content type, `nosniff`, `no-store`, CSP, length and GET/HEAD
  parity are checked. Invalid routes/queries/methods do not invoke the builder;
  builder/export failures do not leak the injected error or partial CSV.

No browser ran for this slice. These tests do not prove browser navigation, remote
authorization, consumer routing, secret/paid-source exclusion or general content
sanitization. Applications still own their domain and authorization boundaries.

## Retained execution

Private root: `/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-analytics-security.o3SeE8`.
Focused recipe tests pass. `run-06-default-temp-packages/` then passes Gallery,
the static-content command, `ui/analytics` and `ui/vizframe` with Go 1.26.3 and the
existing offline module caches. Source/test snapshots, commands, environment and
outputs are retained; this is not an independent cold or hermetic build.

Earlier closure-preparation and receipt-wrapper failures remain separate. The broad
`run-04-packages/` exposed positive static-export fixtures using macOS's `/var`
temporary-root alias despite the exporter's canonical-parent requirement. The
two test files now resolve their positive temporary roots; explicit symlink refusal
tests and production policy are unchanged. The final run inherits the ordinary
`/var/folders/.../T/` test root, with only compiler `GOTMPDIR` on the external volume.
Changing the environment alone was not accepted as the fixture repair.
